description: Phase 36 smoke eval (~30 pairs). Records are built from `records`; every query must surface its expected_marker record in the top-10 citations in BOTH reranker modes.

records.title: network retry policy (SMK_ERR_CONN_RESET_31)
records.body_md: The gateway retries transient provider failures. Error SMK_ERR_CONN_RESET_31 signals a dropped upstream socket during streaming; retry with jittered backoff.

records.title: frontend auth state (SMK_USEAUTHSTORE_HOOK)
records.body_md: The web app keeps session state in the SMK_USEAUTHSTORE_HOOK zustand store; tokens refresh five minutes before expiry.

records.title: flaky checkout test (SMK_TICKET_4821)
records.body_md: 2026-06-30: QA rejected the checkout PR under SMK_TICKET_4821 because a shared fixture leaked a cart row between tests.

records.title: database pooling runbook (SMK_RUNBOOK_PGBOUNCER)
records.body_md: Runbook SMK_RUNBOOK_PGBOUNCER: always size the pgbouncer pool to 2x worker concurrency and alert at 80 percent saturation.

records.title: release freeze policy (SMK_DEPLOY_FREEZE_RULE)
records.body_md: Policy SMK_DEPLOY_FREEZE_RULE: no production deploys on Fridays after 15:00 or during an active incident bridge.

records.title: billing component map (SMK_COMPONENT_BILLING)
records.body_md: Component map SMK_COMPONENT_BILLING: billing-service owns /invoices and /payments; ledger entries are append-only.

records.title: redis outage postmortem (SMK_INCIDENT_0609)
records.body_md: 2026-06-09 incident SMK_INCIDENT_0609: a full redis eviction wiped rate-limit counters; mitigation added persistence.

records.title: python import style (SMK_STYLE_IMPORTS)
records.body_md: Convention SMK_STYLE_IMPORTS: prefer module imports over symbol imports for services; ban wildcard imports everywhere.

records.title: nightly schema drift check (SMK_SCHEMA_DRIFT_JOB)
records.body_md: The nightly job SMK_SCHEMA_DRIFT_JOB diffs production schema against migrations and pages the on-call on drift.

records.title: pull request checklist (SMK_PR_TEMPLATE_V3)
records.body_md: Checklist SMK_PR_TEMPLATE_V3: every PR needs a rollback note, a test plan, and a linked decision when behavior changes.

records.title: consumer lag alerting (SMK_KAFKA_LAG_ALERT)
records.body_md: Alert SMK_KAFKA_LAG_ALERT fires when consumer lag exceeds five minutes of production traffic on any partition.

records.title: retry storm lesson (SMK_LESSON_RETRY_STORM)
records.body_md: Lesson SMK_LESSON_RETRY_STORM: unbounded client retries amplified the 2026-05 outage; all SDKs now cap at three attempts.

records.title: search service ownership (SMK_OWNERSHIP_SEARCH)
records.body_md: Ownership note SMK_OWNERSHIP_SEARCH: the discovery squad owns query parsing; ranking weights belong to relevance guild.

records.title: on-call handoff steps (SMK_ONCALL_HANDOFF)
records.body_md: Runbook SMK_ONCALL_HANDOFF: outgoing on-call writes a summary, transfers open pages, and reviews silenced alerts together.

records.title: timezone rollover bug (SMK_BUG_TZ_ROLLOVER)
records.body_md: 2026-04-12 bug SMK_BUG_TZ_ROLLOVER: report totals doubled at DST rollover because bucketing used local time.
